name: Fewest Moves LA 2019

venue.name: Bridges Academy
venue.address: 3921 Laurel Canyon Blvd, Studio City, CA 91604

information: Please note this competition is 13 hours long. If you do not make it past a round, you do not need to stay. First time competitors may compete, but please note that there is only the Fewest Moves event. Spectators are ***not allowed*** at this competition. If you need to stay, but are not competing, you will need to wait outside the venue.
